# Scheduled Dairy - Full Stack Application

## Project Overview
A comprehensive task management and productivity application built with Next.js 14, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, MongoDB, and NextAuth.

## Project Structure
- Next.js 14 with App Router
- TypeScript for type safety
- Tailwind CSS for styling
- MongoDB for database
- NextAuth for authentication
- Rich text editor for notes
- PDF upload support
